results.content: # Barriers to consumption of fruits and vegetables and strategies to overcome them in low- and middle-income countries: a narrative review. This review provides an overview of the barriers to the consumption of fruits and vegetables (FVs) as well as strategies to improve the intake of FVs in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs). Trends in the consumption of FVs in LMICs are also summarised.
